SUPRA.name: Daylight Film Emulation
SUPRA.tone_curve: Soft highlight rolloff (10%), gentle shadow lift (2%)
SUPRA.color_grading: Subtle blue lift in shadows, clean highlights
SUPRA.use_case: Outdoor photography, natural light, portraits, landscapes

CHROME.name: Tungsten Film Emulation
CHROME.color_grading: Warm amber shift, golden midtones, glowing highlights
CHROME.use_case: Indoor photography, night scenes, warm artificial light

technical_notes: All processing done in linear RGB with gamma correction
Color shifts applied in sRGB for perceptual accuracy
Shadow lift preserves detail (no crushed blacks)
